settings.text: Lithium (as orotate) 5 mg. No blend, no proprietary formula, nothing else to decode.

settings.title: Vegan capsules
settings.text: One a day. One month per bottle. No fillers, no colours.

settings.q_text: Isn't lithium the thing they give people in hospitals?? How is this safe to just buy online
settings.a_text: Different thing. The hospital drug is lithium carbonate at 300 to 900 mg with blood tests. This is 5 mg of the mineral as orotate. I was nervous too, read up on it for a month before ordering. Two bottles in now.
settings.f_text: ok update: ordered after this. week 3 and my husband asked what changed. nothing changed, I just stopped snapping.

settings.q_text: Does this actually do anything or is it placebo? Honest answers pls
settings.a_text: Honest answer: nothing for the first two weeks. Around week three I noticed I hadn't had a Sunday night spiral in a while. It's not a switch, it's a floor.

settings.q_text: Why this one and not the $9 bottle on Amazon?
settings.a_text: Because the $9 one says 120 mg and never tells you how much is actually lithium. This one prints the actual lithium amount, 5 mg, on the front. That's the whole reason I switched.
